timeline.body: On November 9, 2026, GitHub.com experienced intermittent timeouts between approximately 05:10 and 08:15 UTC. timeline.body: On November 5, 2026, between 23:21 and approximately 23:26 UTC, several GitHub services experienced elevated errors, including Git operations, Issues, Actions, authentication, and API requests. Customers may have encountered failed requests and Git pushes, and some Actions workflow runs were delayed.
